limitations: Only a content-verified private copy of the selected Ghidra project is opened; its original files are never passed to Ghidra or saved by REA+.
Original project auto-analysis completeness and import settings are unknown. Auto-analysis and import-time overrides are not applied; local bridge preparation runs on the private copy.
Saved seed reports are historical project metadata, not seeds applied by this session. Mutating analyst operations are unavailable and the private copy is deleted on close.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
External functions and local thunks are distinct; procedure metadata identifies both and preserves a thunk target when Ghidra resolves one.
macOS sessions require a matching executable Ghidra native decompiler; REA+ checks for it but does not build native components or change Gatekeeper quarantine state.
